summary: Admin UI: surface guest queries — ip-name, query in/out, spend; add guest bucket to overview
description: Depends on guest_queries being populated. Give admin visibility on guests (incl. non-converted): (1) a Guests list page under (admin)/admin/guests with ip_name, IP, query_text/response_text (in/out), model, cost_usd, converted_user_id, created_at, and a converted-vs-not filter; a detail view like admin/queries/[id]. (2) Add guest aggregates to src/lib/admin-queries.ts + /api/admin/overview: a guest spend bucket alongside pro/free in fetchOverviewStats + fetchDailySeries (SUM(cost_usd) FROM guest_queries), and guest query counts. Keep guest spend in a SEPARATE bucket — do not silently merge into the free/pro tier totals. Tests for the new aggregates.
